feeds.title: Guzman's Greenhouse Gardening Blog
feeds.description: Articles about Southwest plants trees shrubs and native plants. Guzman's Greenhouse has been in business since November of 2014. Owned and operated by Gary Guzman.

feeds.title: Giant Veggie Gardener
feeds.description: Giant Veggie Gardener is a blog by an 'artisan farmer' who is a organic vegetable grower and practices sustainable methods. Shares methods in growing, harvesting, processing and cooking.

feeds.title: Albuquerque Herbalism Blog
feeds.description: Albuquerque Herbalism is a bioregional herbal studies program that brings students into relationships with the medicinal plants of the Southwest through classroom discussion, hands-on remedy making, field trips, and native medicinal plant restoration.

feeds.title: R & S Landscaping
feeds.description: Like working with a smart, dedicated team of professionals who offer creative solutions to your landscaping challenges? Look no further than R&S Landscaping in Albuquerque, NM. We will provide you with the best landscaping services you need, from start to finish.

feeds.title: Santa Fe Landscape Pros Blog
feeds.description: Read our articles to learn about landscaping maintenance and restoration, as well as how to improve your patio, walkways, stonework, and more. Santa Fe Landscape Pros provides premier local landscaping services in Santa Fe, NM, and the surrounding area.

feeds.title: Waterwise Gardening
feeds.description: David's tips and tricks for your garden. David is a 1979 graduate of Colorado State University with a degree in Horticultural Science. He is a specialist, propagating and growing WATERWISE plants. WATERWISE Gardening is a plant breeding horticultural company specializing in introducing ornamental and pollinator habitat-improving plants.

feeds.title: Seeds & Stones Blog
feeds.description: My name is Erin and I am a mama, wife, homesteader, gardener, teacher, jewelry designer, crafter, and general creative Aquarian spirit. I live in the high desert of New Mexico with my growing family on a tiny, overflowing piece of earth. With my many interests and endeavors I decided to create this blog, Seeds & Stones - A Life Homegrown, as a place to share ideas, tips, inspirations, and the sweetness of life in hopes of sharing little light with the world.

feeds.title: Jericho Nursery Blog
feeds.description: Find helpful and trendy gardening grown tips and information from Jericho Nursery's blog.
